name: Vasilis Ieropoulos
bio: Vasilis Ieropoulos is a Postdoctoral Researcher at the KIOS Centre of Excellence, University of Cyprus, and a member of the Cyber-Physical Systems Security Lab. His research focuses on intrusion detection for resource-constrained IoT devices, federated learning at the edge, radio frequency vulnerabilities, and GPS/GNSS interference. He has published on collaborative intrusion detection, RF security, and cyber range federation.
shortBio: Postdoctoral researcher in IoT security, intrusion detection, and embedded systems.
